CustomField.formula: IF(AND( Direct_Debit_authorised__c = TRUE, DATEVALUE(Direct_Debit_Authorised_Date__c) < TODAY(), ISNULL(Direct_Debit_Details_Entry_Date__c)= FALSE, LEN(dd_sort_code__c)=6 , LEN(dd_account_number__c)=8 , TEXT(Enqix_Payment_Method__c)= "Direct Debit") , TRUE, FALSE)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For the DD to be active the following needs to be true - Enqix Payment Method = Direct Debit DD Authorised = True Direct Debit Authorised Date < Today Direct Debit Details Entry Date is filled out DD Sort Code and Account Number have the right number of digits.
CustomField.label: Active Direct Debit
